schema_notes.market_kind_proposed: Maps to a new MARKET_KIND_* constant to be added in state/market.rs. Each kind has its own 64-byte payload layout — see state/market.rs docstring.
schema_notes.resolver_class: Routes to a specific resolver worker implementation in packages/backend/src/resolvers/. Each class consumes resolver_config and emits signed resolutions on trigger.
schema_notes.comparator: One of: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq. Applied to feed value vs threshold.
schema_notes.rolling_window_seconds: Resolver checks every poll if ANY contiguous window of this length within outcome_window_seconds breached the threshold.
schema_notes.outcome_window_seconds: Total time window during which the event can resolve. After this, market resolves NO unless YES triggered earlier.
schema_notes.demo_eligible: If true, this event is included in the Day-1 demo set (5 markets). Other events get added in subsequent days.
